managed_power_states.description: PMBus output disabled (OPERATION off or CONTROL pin de-asserted per ON_OFF_CONFIG).
Output enabled and regulating to the commanded VOUT.
Output margined up/down per OPERATION for test.
Output disabled by a fault response.

fields.output_enable_logic: Output enable is the combination of the OPERATION command, the CONTROL pin, and ON_OFF_CONFIG (which selects the controlling source(s), polarity, and turn-off behavior).
fields.bus_power: SMBCLK/SMBDAT/SMBALERT# are pulled up to VDD; the bus interface is low-power. PMBus targets manage the converter's own power output, not the bus rail.
fields.notes: PMBus is fundamentally a power-management protocol: it controls converter output enable/voltage/margining via OPERATION + CONTROL + ON_OFF_CONFIG and reports power telemetry and faults. The SMBus bus itself is a low-power open-drain control bus.
